exposure: New wording frozen before implementing or running the qualification-view pilot. The owner has prior access to the reviewed corpus, scientific scope reports and the exposed I06 failure. These are source-informed use checks, not blind tasks, unexposed scientific problems or an untouched held-out comparison. They remain outside implementation fixtures. No question-specific term expansion or ranking rule is authorized by this file.

cases.query: At the operating parameter our prepared density matrix equals the target equilibrium state exactly. Does this certify the correct local Fisher information response as the parameter changes?
cases.scope: State accuracy even at zero pointwise error does not acquire parameter derivative control; preserve independent detector/Gibbs premises.

cases.query: I need a predictor for the full record of a reset-and-read controller, including a very rare starting branch. What finite-data preparation and paid read opportunities make the guarantee meaningful?
cases.scope: Certified positive predictive models, actual starts and rare-opportunity costs; no free conditioning or universal topology inference.

cases.query: I want to combine random subroutines into a reusable output record whose entire law survives later processing. Each child has a standalone law and a finite paid execution cap. What extra joint-record information does the compiler need?
cases.scope: Full acquired joint Gaussian input law, known covariance and value-independent metadata plus gauges/reserve/precision; marginal laws are insufficient.

cases.query: A symmetry-breaking control couples an embedded two-particle state to a bath. What turns a positive spectral density into a visible local response pole while keeping the physical Hamiltonian self-adjoint?
cases.scope: Dressed source and full hard-core local continued-response theorem; physical nonreal eigenvalues not claimed, radius positive but unevaluated.

cases.query: An exact positive spring-network realization matches my desired band endpoints. Does that already certify useful thermal performance under finite manufacturing error and realistic contacts?
cases.scope: Exact scalar inverse realization is not a tolerance/contact/material/device certificate; all bands and precision costs remain.

cases.query: I have complete rational bounds on response residual derivatives and anchor values. Can I exclude every remote control value from beating a candidate and certify a small regret near it, rather than relying on sampled fits?
cases.scope: Whole-domain exclusion plus local curvature/gradient on the actual fixed box, conditional supplied complete norms; distinguish fixed two-control result and no fresh norm regeneration.

cases.query: A stationary reversible spin bath has a proven information-rate bound for estimating its mean magnetization from one long average. Does that limit the information in the complete observed trajectory too?
cases.scope: Mean-procedure bound does not bound full trajectory Fisher information or every estimator/metrology protocol.

cases.query: A rank-one-convex quartic has a certificate excluding constant positive spatial diffusion with quadratic closed-form corrections. Does that settle its quasiconvexity, or exclude state-dependent and nonlocal methods?
cases.scope: Only exact constant-SPD/closed-quadratic/bilinear-SOS class excluded; no quasiconvexity/Morrey or universal diffusion conclusion.
